title: Basin Street West and the live Encore album
summary: On their first Los Angeles visit at Basin Street West the band recorded live, with stars like Nat Cole and Mancini in the audience.

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California

blocks.x: Yeah. And, of course, I think when we came to hit the coast with it the first time, at Basin Street West in L.A., --
And we just -- the Encore album, there.
And I don't think there was anybody in this town who didn't become aware of the band.
Everybody from Nat Cole to Henry Mancini was there while we were recording this album live.
Yeah, that was exciting for you, I remember. That was just before you came up here to the Basin Street West (inaudible) here.
